thesis: The evidence matrix separates robust findings, contextual associations, disputed mechanisms and speculation.
role: Audit hierarchy of certainty across the book.

ideas.statement: Cultural/genetic mechanisms must be distinguished from proposed AI and demographic scenarios.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Endogamy and rice/wheat studies occupy the stronger evidence group; alignment-demography is speculation.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Psychopathy, political orientation and polygenic education correlations are contextual.
Self-domestication and rapid genetic selection remain disputed.

audit.notes: Entire assigned batch read; numbered subchapters covered; no independent citation verification.
